el.Biografías ilustradas del rock argentino: Illustrated biographies of Argentine rock to read, listen to and share as a family.
el.Somos Mavela y Mario Rossini. Animales d: We are Mavela and Mario Rossini. Animales del Rock began as a self-managed cultural venture to change the way kids discover Argentina's musical legacy: books that don't just inform, but move.
el.Mavela ilustra, Mario escribe. Cada libr: Mavela illustrates, Mario writes. Every book has QR codes so you can listen to the music while you read, and tells the life stories of Charly, Cerati and el Flaco for all ages. A bridge between generations.
el.Hacemos libros que sean un puente cultur: We make books that act as a cultural, musical, cross-generational bridge.
